protocol: Astra prover -> separate fresh Astra referee (claim+report+data only). Built from referee verdict.json files only; a claim is accepted iff its referee verdict is CORRECT/CORRECT_WITH_FIXES (fixes adopted in PROOF_NOTES.md). Strategy round: proposals/rankings are UNVERIFIED and not accepted.
headline_verified: Uniform endpoint transport (L1), endpoint contact budget (L2, h>=3), endpoint potential (L3), shielding loss (L4, r>=q-4), bipartite plateau => every vertex starts P_(2K+1) (L5; explains all path-free RC controls)

Safe edge <=> on no pentagon; contraction loses 2-t_e, p(G/U)<=p(G); transversal inequality => every edge of a minimum GEN_K counterexample (K>=2) lies on a pentagon; integral pentagon packing (triangle-free) and triangle-corrected half-integral packing
Endpoint-deficit bound; full-six residual: deficits in {0,1,2}, all 0 if t(z)=2; safe-contraction metric theorem (p-r can increase); saturation retention fails

required_fixes: State h>=3 explicitly in Lemma 2 and retain that scope in its corollaries.
State that r>=q-4 remains assumed in (11); the mass premise on U alone does not suffice.
Correct independent_arms.sum_lengths from 8 to 6 and remove maximum from the description of the displayed three-edge arms, or replace both witnesses by the actual four-edge maximum arms.

Strengthen certificate validation to compare stored arm lengths/sums and maximality with the witnesses and exact searches; regenerate the affected JSON, verification report and manifest after editing.
For clarity, retain the optimal-path hypothesis in the weighted-transition paragraph, specify the audit orientation/incidence conventions, and name the Robertson statistic as E[ceil(|P|/2)].

required_fixes.problem: Noncompleteness does not imply radius at least two; P3 is a counterexample to that inference.
required_fixes.replacement: The seven-vertex quotient has maximum degree three, so it has no universal vertex and radius at least two. The exhibited vertex of eccentricity two therefore proves r=2.
